Which statements about elements in Group VIII of the Periodic Table are correct?
1
Atoms of the elements have full outer electron shells.
2
They are diatomic.
3
They are gaseous at room temperature and pressure.
4
They react with water.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
